justification: Inspected core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/report/suggestion/SuggestionWalker.java, which is the only class in this package. It depends on core/model/report/util/compilation packages, and repo-wide searches show the package is referenced only twice (ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/main/JITWatchUI.java:387 and core/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/launch/LaunchHeadless.java:202), while the internal packages it uses are referenced far more broadly (model 208 files, util 102, freelogj 57, report 25, compilation 24). That makes the package relatively unstable itself, but there is no evidence it depends on packages that are less stable than itself.
